name: Abnormality Adventures I: Scarlet-sama's Family
source:
A part dating sim part family-raising sim about a reclusive vampire coming out of his shell. And also, something about Tragedy...?

[From [url=https://twitter.com/abnormalityadv/status/1033128952305463296]Twitter[/url]]
